description: Labelled queries over corpus.json. `relevant` lists labelled units: a document id (any passage counts) or 'doc#n' (only that passage). An empty list marks an unanswerable query. `stale` (revision queries only) lists passages from a superseded revision or an informal note that state an outdated answer: the revision-safety metric counts a query as unsafe when a stale unit ranks above the first relevant one, or when the relevant unit is not retrieved at all. Categories: answerable, identifier, quoted, negation, date, table, revision, unanswerable.
